text:
Ada Park: quick ask — need a compact benchmark one-pager + two social tiles for the webinar launch (audience split: technical & executive). key visual: sparkline showing latency vs cost, small table with top-3 model choices and per-token cost. sizes: 1200x628 (social landscape) and 800x800 (social square). one-pager: US letter + PDF export. brand-safe colors only. deadline: EOD Tue PST. routing: make sure webinar registrants map to SFDC campaign + tag 'wm24-bench'. ETA?
Maria Chen: got it. can you confirm the tone differences for the two variants? more data-heavy for tech, simplified bullets for execs?
Ada Park: yes exactly. tech = raw numbers, callouts for batching/quant. exec = 3 bullets on business impact (latency, cost, reliability) + CTA to book demo. also add speaker names and webinar date in footer.
Kevin Ortiz: speaker blurbs should be short — 1 line each. also want an alternate hero for the registration page (1600x900) that matches the one-pager visual language.
Maria Chen: ack. planning filenames: `wm24_onepager_bench_v1.pdf`, `wm24_social_tech_1200x628.png`, `wm24_social_exec_800x800.png`, `wm24_reg_hero_1600x900.jpg`. will handoff source (Figma) + exportables to /brand/marketing/wm24-assets. any logo lockups or legal copy?
Ada Park: use current logo lockup from brand kit, no legal copy beyond © Redwood Inference 2026. include attribution line: "Model benchmarks internal — do not republish" in small footer.
Jordan Li: numbers to include for the sparkline: median latency 45ms -> 80ms across model variants; cost per 1k tokens: $0.35 -> $0.08 as quantized variants. use this sample series for the sparkline: [45, 50, 55, 63, 72, 80] and costs [0.35, 0.30, 0.25, 0.18, 0.12, 0.08]. preference: overlay latency and cost axes with dual y labels, or two mini-sparklines side-by-side if simpler.
Maria Chen: thanks — will prototype both overlay + split versions and share screens tomorrow. for accessibility: will include alt text and an accessible PDF tagging. any copy for alt text?
Ada Park: alt text brief: "Sparkline comparing model latency (ms) and per-1k token cost; latency rises from 45ms to 80ms while cost falls from $0.35 to $0.08 for quantized variants." keep under 250 chars.
brand-bot: Brand checklist reminder — confirm primary palette (REDWOOD-500 #B91C1C) + neutral greys only. Max 2 typefaces: Inter for body, GT Aligned for headings. Export PNG/JPG at 2x for retina. Accessibility: 4.5:1 contrast ratio required for text. Link: https://brand/redwood-guidelines (internal).
Kevin Ortiz: routing tech check — marketing ops, make sure registration form has hidden field `campaign=wm24-bench` and `lead_tag=benchkit` so Sales can route. Jordan, can you confirm if Sales needs any custom mapping? @Jordan Li
Jordan Li: yep, Sales wants `owner_pool=bench_sales` when MQL threshold met. I'll send the mapping table to ops after this thread.
Maria Chen: timeline: initial comps by EOD Mon, refined versions Tue morning, final exports Tue EOD. will add a version note in the Figma files.
Ada Park: perfect. please @me when comps are ready. also small ask — include a tiny diagram (3-step) for inbound lead routing that we can drop into the one-pager: 1) Register (form) -> 2) Qualified (ops) -> 3) Book demo (sales). simple icons only.
Maria Chen: noted — will include a thin-line 3-step diagram. thanks! :sparkles:
Ada Park: thanks team :thumbsup:
